purpose: Carry enough semantic state through one-message correction work to return the human to the same study task without making raw scroll or transcript context the primary identity.

identity_boundary.rule: A surface-only change thread must not invent page_id or canonical route while registry authority is unresolved. Candidate work may pin exact path/blob without promoting identity.

target_path.rule: Must be exact repository path when candidate bytes are targeted; path presence does not grant product authority.

target_source_blob.rule: Required before any material candidate edit; re-fetch/CAS before integration.

semantic_anchor.rule: Preferred task-location locator when available; must not contain raw private note text.

viewport_fallback.rule: Fallback only; semantic context outranks raw scroll coordinates.

explicit_shelf_position.rule: Only restore when intentionally captured; otherwise newly rendered semester shelves retain their start-origin invariant.

restoration_precedence: resolve surface_id and authority status without guessing
reopen exact candidate/current target only when its binding class is explicit
use viewport_fallback only if semantic restoration is insufficient
restore horizontal shelf position only when explicitly captured
one_message_flow: The page/surface captures this capsule plus a private human correction through shared Capture/Page Change Thread infrastructure.
Public coordination receives only sanitized routing/context fields; raw/private intent and private attachments do not become public queue material.
The Page Thread Bridge produces deterministic candidate work without inventing page_id for this unresolved surface.
Workers edit only exact candidate scope with source-blob pinning; Local Steward reconciles conflicting returns and preserves authority boundaries.

The return payload reopens the exact semantic study context described by this capsule; if canonical route remains unresolved, it must identify the result as candidate-only rather than pretending a canonical Facultad page exists.
privacy_rules: Do not store raw private correction text in public coordination artifacts.
Do not store attachment contents, secrets, personal study notes or derived private content in this public capsule.
Explicit IDs never bypass source privacy.
If Context Foundry v2 participates later, derived privacy inherits the strongest source privacy.

failure_states.action: Fail closed on canonical route/page identity; candidate work may continue only against explicitly pinned candidate bytes.
Stop material integration and rebase/reconcile; never last-writer-wins.
Return to the nearest semantically valid context and expose which fields were unavailable; do not fabricate tab/year/anchor.
Keep private payload outside public coordination and deny selection across insufficient authority.
